title: Retried ingestion and duplicate discovery do not multiply records
setup: Fresh product; inject a BlobStore wrapper that throws retryable ProductError once when storing web-002, then delegates to MemoryBlobStore
operations: enqueue with new key s06-next and run worker once

expectedStateChanges.firstAttempt: 1 indexed; job retry; page checkpoint remains 0
expectedStateChanges.secondAttempt: 2 total records, 2 total features; checkpoint 4; job completed with attempts=2
expectedStateChanges.sameKey: same batch and job IDs; no new records
expectedStateChanges.newKey: empty completed batch from checkpoint 4; still 2 total records
